name: group_list
description: List the groups you can report on, with their communities. Call this first to learn group jids and names.

group_jids.description: Only these group/community jids. Omit for all available groups.

fields.description: Extra fields to include; jid and name are always returned. Omit for no extra fields.

limit.description: At most this many groups per page (default 100, maximum 200). This is a hard upper bound: a page may contain fewer rows when they are verbose — always continue from next_offset, not from offset + limit.

parent_jid.description: Jid of the community this group belongs to, absent for top-level.

bot_role.description: The bot account's role in the group.

announcement_only.description: True when only admins can post in the group.

bot_can_post.description: True when the bot is able to post in the group (it is not announcement-only, or the bot is an admin).

last_activity.description: Datetime of the most recent activity in the group, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' in the {{timezone}} timezone; absent if none recorded.

join_approval_required.description: True when new members need admin approval to join.

has_more.description: True when more rows match beyond this page.

next_offset.description: Pass this as offset to fetch the next page. Present only when has_more is true.

name: group_members
description: List members of the groups and their activity.

group_jids.description: Only these group/community jids. Omit for all available groups.

fields.description: Extra fields to include; lid and name are always returned. 'groups' lists which groups the member belongs to. Omit for all fields.

activity_from.description: Start of the activity window, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' in the {{timezone}} timezone. Default: 30 days ago.

activity_to.description: End of the activity window, same format. Default: now.

name_contains.description: Filter: display name contains this text (case-insensitive).

phone_contains.description: Filter: phone number contains these digits.

min_activity_count.description: Filter: at least this many activities in the window.

max_activity_count.description: Filter: at most this many activities in the window. Use 0 to find completely inactive members.

last_activity_before.description: Filter: last activity older than this datetime, or never active.

last_activity_after.description: Filter: active at or after this datetime.

order_by.description: Sort key. Only lid and phone are unique; any other key uses lid as a tie-breaker. Default: lid.

limit.description: At most this many members per page (default 50, maximum 500). This is a hard upper bound: a page may contain fewer rows when they are verbose — always continue from next_offset, not from offset + limit.

name.description: Display name when known. WhatsApp only reveals names on activity, so members who never posted may have no name.

last_activity.description: Datetime of the member's latest activity in the window; absent if none.

groups.description: Jids of the groups the member belongs to.

last_read.description: Date the member last read a message from the monitoring account in this group ('YYYY-MM-DD'). Only tracked for members with read receipts enabled, and only for the account's own messages — absent otherwise. Useful to spot members who read but never post.

total.description: Members matching the filters, before paging.

has_more.description: True when more rows match beyond this page.

next_offset.description: Pass this as offset to fetch the next page. Present only when has_more is true.

name: group_messages
description: Read messages the way participants see them (final edited text; polls, events and reactions resolved; deleted messages excluded unless include_deleted). Do not count activity by paging through this tool — use activity_stats for counts.

group_jids.description: Only these group/community jids. Omit for all available groups.

from.description: Range start (inclusive), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' in the {{timezone}} timezone. Default: 7 days ago.

to.description: Range end (inclusive), same format. Default: now.

types.description: Kinds of items to return; votes, responses, edits and reactions are folded into their parent item. Default: all kinds.

has_reactions.description: Filter: only items that received reactions.

order.description: asc = oldest first (use for summarizing a period or reading from a timestamp), desc = newest first. Default: asc.

limit.description: At most this many items per page (default 50, maximum 200). This is a hard upper bound: a page may contain fewer rows when they are verbose — always continue from next_offset, not from offset + limit.

member_lid.description: Filter: only items this member was involved in — they authored it, reacted to it, replied to it, voted in the poll, responded to the event, or deleted it (admins can delete others' messages); plus replies to this member's messages and messages mentioning this member.

include_deleted.description: Include deleted messages, marked with deleted/deleted_by and shown with their last known content. Useful when inspecting spam that admins already removed. Default false.

id.description: WhatsApp's message id, unique within the group. reply_to_id and message_search hits use the same id space and name.

name.description: Display name when known; may be absent.

text.description: Message text or caption, final version after any edits.

edited.description: Present and true when the text was edited.

reply_to_id.description: WhatsApp message id of the message this one replies to, when it is a reply.

by.description: Members who reacted with this emoji. Each entry is one member as '<lid> <phone> <name>': lid digits, then phone digits (or '-' when unknown), then the display name (may be empty). lid guarantees uniqueness; split on the first two spaces to parse.

votes.description: Members who voted for this option. Each entry is one member as '<lid> <phone> <name>': lid digits, then phone digits (or '-' when unknown), then the display name (may be empty). lid guarantees uniqueness; split on the first two spaces to parse.

going.description: Members who responded "going". Each entry is one member as '<lid> <phone> <name>': lid digits, then phone digits (or '-' when unknown), then the display name (may be empty). lid guarantees uniqueness; split on the first two spaces to parse.

maybe.description: Members who responded "maybe". Each entry is one member as '<lid> <phone> <name>': lid digits, then phone digits (or '-' when unknown), then the display name (may be empty). lid guarantees uniqueness; split on the first two spaces to parse.

not_going.description: Members who responded "not going". Each entry is one member as '<lid> <phone> <name>': lid digits, then phone digits (or '-' when unknown), then the display name (may be empty). lid guarantees uniqueness; split on the first two spaces to parse.

media.description: Present when the message carried non-text content, e.g. 'image', 'video', 'sticker', 'voice message', 'audio', 'document: <filename>', 'location', 'live location', 'contact'. The media itself is never included; text carries the caption when there is one.

deleted.description: Present and true when the message was deleted (only returned when include_deleted is true).

deleted_by.description: Who deleted the message; may differ from the author when an admin removed it.

name.description: Display name when known; may be absent.

total.description: Messages matching the filters, before paging.

has_more.description: True when more rows match beyond this page.

next_offset.description: Pass this as offset to fetch the next page. Present only when has_more is true.

name: activity_stats
description: Count activity over one or more explicit date ranges — the reliable way to answer 'how many' and 'how active' questions.

group_jids.description: Only these group/community jids. Omit for all available groups.

participant_lids.description: Restrict to these members: counts and member numbers cover only their activity. Omit for everyone.

from.description: Range start (inclusive), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' in the {{timezone}} timezone.

ranges.description: 1 to 12 explicit ranges to count over, e.g. one per month for a monthly breakdown.

categories.description: Which activity blocks to include in counts: primary (messages, polls, events), corrective (edits, own deletes), secondary (reactions, poll votes, event responses). Default: all three. The members block is always returned.

rows.description: One row per group per requested range. When more than one group is covered, an extra row per range has group_jid 'total' and aggregates across all requested groups: counts sum, but member numbers are distinct persons (someone active in several groups counts once — e.g. 5 active in group A and 4 in group B can be 7 overall), and joined/left sum as events.

counts.description: Only the requested category blocks are present; each block is always complete.

own_deletes.description: Messages deleted by their own author.

contributors.description: Distinct members with at least one primary action (message, poll, event) in the range.

engagers.description: Distinct members with ANY activity in the range — primary or secondary — so engagers is always >= contributors (posting counts as engagement).

participants.description: Distinct members observed in the group during the range: engagers plus members whose read receipts show they read it (so participants >= engagers). Approximate — receipts are opt-in and only cover the monitoring account's messages — and only computable when the range extends to the present; absent for past ranges.

joined.description: Members who joined during the range (recorded going forward from when this feature was deployed).

left.description: Members who left or were removed during the range (recorded going forward).

members.description: Member engagement numbers for the row. Omitted when the call filters by a single participant — the numbers would all be 0 or 1.

name: message_search
description: Find where something was discussed by searching message texts. To read the surrounding conversation, call group_messages with from set to a hit's sent_at and order asc.

query.description: Search alternatives, combined with OR: a message matches when it satisfies at least one entry. Within an entry ALL words must appear (AND), in any order; wrap words in "double quotes" to require an exact phrase. Example: ["picnic saturday", "\"beach volleyball\""] finds messages with both picnic and saturday, or the exact phrase beach volleyball.

group_jids.description: Only these group/community jids. Omit for all available groups.

author_lid.description: Only messages written by this member.

from.description: Range start (inclusive), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' in the {{timezone}} timezone. Default: no lower bound.

to.description: Range end (inclusive), same format. Default: now.

order.description: Order of hits by date: asc = oldest first, desc = newest first. Default: desc.

limit.description: At most this many hits per page (default 20, maximum 100). This is a hard upper bound: a page may contain fewer rows when they are verbose — always continue from next_offset, not from offset + limit.

hits.description: Matching messages, ordered by sent_at per the order parameter (newest first by default).

id.description: WhatsApp's message id (same id space and name as group_messages.id).

name.description: Display name when known; may be absent.

has_more.description: True when more rows match beyond this page.

next_offset.description: Pass this as offset to fetch the next page. Present only when has_more is true.
